card.name: Linking words before kidney-failure terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words or commas (to, including, of, for, and) that come right before a kidney-injury or clotting-microangiopathy term such as renal failure or thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura.

modes.label: Link before renal failure
modes.description: A word like to or for that leads into renal failure as a reported outcome or risk.
modes.example: Crystalluria, in some cases leading<< to>> renal failure, has also been reported after

modes.label: Link inside thrombotic microangiopathy lists
modes.description: Including, and, or a comma that introduces TTP, hemolytic uremic syndrome or related findings.
